facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 53°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left Buckinghorse (4,850 ft) and Mount Crag (3,960 ft) 24 to 32 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Buckinghorse
evidence.detail: left May 20; earlier seasons: June 11 (2023), June 13 (2024), June 15 (2025)

evidence.name: Mount Crag
evidence.detail: left May 8; earlier seasons: June 11 (2023), June 5 (2024), June 9 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Buckinghorse (4,850 ft) and Mount Crag (3,960 ft).

evidence.name: Buckinghorse
evidence.detail: 28.4 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 54.9 in (2023), 36.2 in (2024), 54.4 in (2025)

evidence.name: Mount Crag
evidence.detail: 14.8 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 43.4 in (2023), 22.0 in (2024), 36.7 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between May 4 and July 4, carried from the melt-out dates at Buckinghorse (4,850 ft) and Mount Crag (3,960 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Buckinghorse
evidence.detail: melted out May 20, 718 ft below the pass; points to May 6 to June 28

evidence.name: Mount Crag
evidence.detail: melted out May 8, 1,608 ft below the pass; points to May 3 to July 9
